shared_elements: horizontal row of repeated rectangular blocks resembling crenellation/battlement
band of triangles or zigzag pattern
tall vertical element rising above the composition (mast / pole)
justification: Both surfaces contain a horizontal register of repeated rectangular blocks that reads as a crenellated or toothed band, together with a triangular/zigzag border and a hatched, grid-filled area, which gives a superficial resemblance between A's ship with its row of shield-like squares and B's battlemented city wall. Otherwise the depicted content differs fundamentally: B shows a narrative siege with human archers, a wheeled engine and a towered gate with an arched opening, while A shows a single mast-and-hull vessel with no discernible figures or action, and the rendering differs from schematic outline to modelled figural relief.
